integrity: Finite enumeration confirms small cases; the infinite theorem rests on the proved affine-congruence collision estimate and hypergeometric limit. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed subset size as group order tends to infinity; no uniform growing-size bounds, no exact finite crossover, no full-power-set dominance result. Earlier implicit coverage is a residual originality risk.
title: Binomial dominance law and a six-point reversal in dicyclic groups
